name: When is the best time of year to replace windows in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to replace windows in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: The mild climate in Southern California generally allows for window replacement year-round. However, many homeowners prefer late spring or early fall. During these seasons, temperatures are moderate, reducing the impact of open walls during installation. Scheduling in these times might also help avoid the peak demand of summer, potentially leading to quicker project initiation. It's always best to consult with a contractor to discuss specific scheduling that works for your home and their availability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Late spring or early fall are often preferred due to mild temperatures, though window replacement can be done year-round in Southern California.
